thread:
maya: Quick idea — can we move the weekly triage out of the 3pm slot? Proposing Tue 10:00 AM (25m) and adding a short 'quick fixes' slot for PRs/bug merges that take <30m. Rationale: fewer carryovers into end of week, better EMEA overlap, and afternoons for deep work. Thoughts?

noah: I like earlier. Tue 10 conflicts with infra retro on our calendar. If retro stays, could we do Mon 10 instead? Quick fixes slot sounds useful.

olivia: I can swap the infra retro if that helps. Is 25m the plan or keep it 30?

maya: Aim is 25m (compact). Proposed agenda (draft):
```
- 00:00-00:05 quick pre-triage checklist (labels, severity, repro)
- 00:05-00:15 bug queue + owner assignment (top 3)
- 00:15-00:22 quick fixes slot (PRs that can merge within 30m)
- 00:22-00:25 actions + followups (who owns what)
```
Also add a small 'blocked-by-infra' review item to catch infra-related blockers.

sarah: Can we standardize the pre-triage checklist somewhere? A short template would speed things up. Also please call out anything needing an RFC/design review separately.

noah: Agree on checklist. I'll volunteer to own the rotation for the next 4 weeks if that helps. Also +1 to a small table in the calendar invite with owner for the week.

olivia: I can take the following two weeks after noah. Maya, can you include the bug dashboard link in the invite so folks can pre-read?

maya: Yep — will update invite and add pre-read + checklist link. Proposed calendar title: "eng triage — morning sync (compact)". If infra retro is sticky, we can pick Mon instead.

engbot: calendar: Event created by @maya — Tue 10:00 AM - 10:25 AM. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/1768500001

sre-oncall: Quick heads-up — on-call rotation has a pager handoff scheduled at 10:00 AM starting next week. That'll be a conflict for the on-call person. If that person is expected to present items, we should avoid 10:00. Suggest 9:45 or 11:00.

maya: Good catch. OK pivot: how about 9:45 AM Tue, same 25m agenda. We'll shrink quick fixes to 7m (15 -> 7) if needed. Anyone blocked by 9:45?

noah: 9:45 works for me.

olivia: Works for me too.

sre-oncall: I'll update the on-call schedule to reflect 9:45-10:10 as safe for rotations.

maya: Final plan: Tue 9:45-10:10, 25m compact triage. Owner rotation: noah (weeks 1-4), olivia (weeks 5-6) — I'll put that table in the invite and the pre-read doc. I'll also add the pre-triage checklist and a link to the bug dashboard. Thanks all :thumbsup:

noah: Thanks — I'll add the checklist template to the doc after this thread.

olivia: Sweet. See you Tue 9:45.

engbot: calendar: Event updated by @maya — Tue 9:45 AM - 10:10 AM. Updated link: https://calendar.example.com/event/1768500001/updated

maya: Done. If anyone has priority items, drop them in the pre-read doc before 8am Tue so we can slot them.

sarah: I'll add a link to the 'blocked-by-infra' tracker in the doc so infra issues are visible in the pre-read.

maya: Awesome — closing the loop here. If anything else comes up, ping me or update the doc.
